apps.name: SwipeClean
apps.subtitle: Swipe through your photos month by month.
apps.localizedDescription: Go through your photo library one month at a time. Swipe left to mark a photo for deletion, right to keep it. Favourite and share photos on the way. Nothing is deleted until you confirm.

versions.localizedDescription: Take app version and build number from build settings

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SwipeClean shows your photos so you can swipe to keep or delete them.

apps.versionDescription: Take app version and build number from build settings
